extracted.intended_audience: USPTO patent examiners; patent attorneys, agents, and applicants seeking guidance on U.S. patent examination procedure
extracted.subtask_description: Table of Contents listing the Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP) chapters and appendices; identifies topical chapters that govern examination practice and related statutory/regulatory materials. Useful as a map of procedural and substantive guidance for patent prosecution and examination.
